title: Tops leak!
text:
Tops leak!. I thought these were ideal for coffee creamers when I received them, but noticed that one of the tops was leaking creamer down the side every time I used it. The other one seemed tp work as intended but over time began to leak also. I now have two glass containers that I can't use.
I can not recommend this to others.
